Name: (CP) Earthy Ridgeside Village
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[size=4][b]About[/b][/size]
This is a Content Patcher conversion of DeonDF's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14369]Earthy Ridgeside recolor mod[/url]. No replacing of Ridgeside assets necessary! Once installed into your Mods folder, this mod with automatically recolor all of the buildings and interiors of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] to match the aesthetic of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]. Uploaded with permission from DeonDF, the original author! In addition to their assets, this mod also includes new recolors of assets added in more recent updates to Ridgeside Village.

[size=4][b]Installation and Removal[/b][/size]
This mod works the same as any other, and it can be added or removed at any time. Simply download, unzip, and place in your Mods folder.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Should be compatible with [b][u]all mods[/u][/b], except for those that also edit the appearance of Ridgeside maps. It's recommended to be used alongside the original Earthy mods, but it is not required. This mod will still work if you're using a different map recolor (or none at all).

Use in combination with the newest version of Ridgeside Village (currently 2.5.12) in order to ensure there are no tilesheet discrepancies.

Mobile compatibility is untested, but should theoretically work (but if it doesn't there's not much I can do about it, since I don't have access to an Android phone).

[size=4][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]
I (Vinilla) plan to maintain this mod for the forseeable future, updating it as Ridgeside updates come out and add new assets.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/471742]DeonDF[/url] - original assets
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/140245483]Vinilla[/url] - Content Patcher conversion and recolor of the interiors & spirit realm tilesheets
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/177065208]Soupysup[/url] - recolor of the spouse rooms tilesheet
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38816245]acerbicon[/url] - tree sprites (featured in spirit realm tilesheets)
